mapper.select: SELECT * FROM app_generation_model_pricing ORDER BY enabled DESC, provider_key ASC, model_pattern ASC, effective_from DESC, id DESC

SELECT * FROM app_generation_model_pricing WHERE enabled = TRUE AND (provider_key = #{providerKey} OR provider_key = '*') AND effective_from <= #{effectiveAt} AND (effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to > #{effectiveAt}) ORDER BY CASE WHEN provider_key = #{providerKey} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, effective_from DESC, id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE app_generation_model_pricing SET provider_key = #{providerKey}, model_pattern = #{modelPattern}, version = #{version}, currency = #{currency}, input_usd_per_million_tokens = #{inputUsdPerMillionTokens}, output_usd_per_million_tokens = #{outputUsdPerMillionTokens}, effective_from = #{effectiveFrom}, effective_to = #{effectiveTo}, enabled = #{enabled}, note = #{note}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
